title: Effective Dates of DIC Claims and the Time Limit for Accrued Benefits
content:
§1 **Timely claim.** A claim for Dependency and Indemnity Compensation (DIC) received within the DIC claim window, counted in calendar days from the veteran's death, is effective the first day of the month of death.

§2 **Later claim.** A DIC claim received after the DIC claim window is effective the date of claim, or the date of an intent to file received within the intent-to-file validity period before it.

§3 **Accrued benefits.** Benefits due to the veteran and unpaid at death are claimed within the accrued-benefits claim window, counted from the veteran's death.

### Reading §1 and §2 together

| When VA received the DIC claim | Intent to file received within the intent-to-file validity period before the claim | Effective date |
|---|---|---|
| Within the DIC claim window after the death | Not relevant | The first day of the month of death |
| After the DIC claim window | Yes | The date VA received that intent to file |
| After the DIC claim window | No | The date of claim |

The two dates that open the clocks are different: the DIC claim window and the accrued-benefits claim window run from the date of the veteran's death, while the intent-to-file period is measured back from the date of the claim to the date the intent to file was received.

### Hypothetical dates

Assume a veteran died on July 18 of a given year.

- **Inside the window.** The DIC claim is received on a day still inside the DIC claim window after July 18. It is effective July 1 of the year of death, whatever the day of the month on which the death occurred.
- **After the window, with an intent to file.** The claim is received after the DIC claim window has closed, and VA had received an intent to file on March 3 of the following year, within the intent-to-file validity period before the claim. The claim is effective March 3.
- **After the window, without a qualifying intent to file.** The claim is received after the DIC claim window has closed, and no intent to file was received within the intent-to-file validity period before it. The claim is effective on the date of claim.
